command: ENCODE long-read RNA GTF -> SQANTI3 qc -> panisoguard adjudicate --pangenome-junctions <whole-genome HPRC deletions> --pangenome-provenance population
data_provenance: TWO real PUBLIC samples: GM12878 (NA12878) ONT dRNA (ENCODE ENCSR368UNC) and K562 ONT dRNA (ENCSR917JIA); SQANTI3 vs GENCODE v49. Pangenome junctions = whole-genome HPRC v1.1 Minigraph-Cactus deletions >=50bp (71,435 junctions, all chr1-22/X/Y). Both samples are OUT of the HPRC graph's 47 assembly samples (non-circular).
notes: Whole-genome pangenome SPECIFICITY on TWO independent real public samples (GM12878 + K562), extending GATE-1 from chr22 to whole-genome on real data: 0 false rescues across 75,740 novel isoforms / 190,713 novel introns vs 71,435 whole-genome HPRC population-deletion junctions. NO novel junction exactly coincides with a population deletion (near-misses at chance level), so reference-bias-via-population-deletion is genuinely rare -- the pangenome axis is a high-specificity guardrail, not a high-yield discovery axis. Honest null on the discovery question, with strong specificity. Fully reproducible from public ENCODE/HPRC inputs (no private data).
